backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing cutoff records, CSV import, and percentile-based admission predictions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking feature IDs to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their purposes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global style sheet defining color variables and theme for backgrounds and components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up root container and loading the main frontend script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the predictor form page inside a styled container.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching a backend canister actor with identity-aware refetch behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth provider and hook handling login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind styles using warm earth-tone OKLCH colors and dark-mode variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, query client, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Full predictor UI handling percentile input, CSV upload, backend predictions, and displaying results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and container settings, with typography, container-query, and animation plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the MHT-CET predictor app, its data schema, prediction rules, frontend milestones, and known issues.
